fusions.name: Branching Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 4 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Parting Pair
fusions.desc: Fires 2 heavy rounds that split apart, each dealing 14 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Spare Muzzle
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set a second loaded piece on a rest beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Either Way
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a shot that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
